full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 27
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Friday, Ashadh 5, 2083
11:00 AM
Management Work
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle:-
1. (a) To present the proposal 'Consider the Economic Bill, 2083'.
(b) To present the proposal 'Consider the National Debt Raising Bill, 2083'.
Ordinance Related Work
2. The proposal 'Reject the Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2083' presented by Honorable Khadga Bahadur Budha will be presented for decision.
3. On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister Balen Shah, Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present the proposal 'Approve the Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2083'.
4. The proposal 'Reject the Prevention of Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2083' presented by Honorable Neeta Ghatani will be presented for decision.
5. Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present the proposal 'Approve the Prevention of Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2083'.
6. The proposal 'Reject the Cooperatives (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2083' presented by Honorable Aaren Rai will be presented for decision.
7. Honorable Minister of Land Management, Cooperatives, and Poverty Alleviation Pratibha Rawal will present the proposal 'Approve the Cooperatives (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2083'.
8. The proposal 'Reject the Ordinance to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institutions, 2083' presented by Honorable Kruparam Rana will be presented for decision.
9. Honorable Minister of Health and Food Security Nisha Mehta will present the proposal 'Approve the Ordinance to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institutions, 2083'.

Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
